about_blocks.text: Crosbie House is a non-profit residential treatment program that provides recovery services for individuals and families suffering from addiction. The dedicated team of physicians, addiction specialists, and volunteers at Crosbie believe that recovery is possible for everyone. The 4-week program includes 1-on-1 counseling sessions, extensive group therapy, acupuncture, art therapy, physical activity, smudging, and 12-step recovery meetings. Crosbie House believes in healing the mind, body, and spirit from the effects of addiction.

Crosbie House believes in healing the mind, body, and spirit from the effects of addiction.

about_blocks.text: The program’s aftercare services include an alumni program, which helps transition individuals back into daily life. Crosbie House also provides an extensive family group program that offers support and education for family members. The family program is held once a week and includes 1-on-1 counseling for family members. Crosbie House provides its clients with a clear path towards recovery, providing them the tools needed to sustain sobriety and achieve lasting results.

about_blocks.text: Situated in the Annapolis Valley, Crosbie House provides a home-like environment for its clients. The sprawling resident grounds create a private and serene setting, offering plenty of space for walking with nearby trails to immerse oneself in the healing power of nature. Yoga, meditation, and physical fitness are all available on-site at the Crosbie House. Clients can experience a tranquil and peaceful environment as they work towards achieving their recovery goals.

Their team of experienced professionals is passionate about providing personalized treatment plans tailored to suit each patient’s unique needs.
